items.title: TreVeyon Henderson: Not available for Week 8
items.text:
Henderson (illness) has been downgraded from questionable to out for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Ian Rapoport of ESPN and NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: A.J. Brown: Won't play against Miami
items.text:
Brown (knee/ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Ian Rapoport of ESPN and NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kyle Monangai: Won't play against Seattle
items.text:
Head coach Ben Johnson told reporters Saturday that Monangai (thumb/toe) will not play against the Seahawks on Monday, Courtney Cronin of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Carnell Tate: Expected back after bye
items.text:
Tate (shoulder) will not play against the Bengals on Sunday but is expected to be back in action following the Titans' bye for Week 10 against the Jaguars on Sunday, Nov. 15, Paul Kuharsky of PaulKuharsky.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jonathan Taylor: Trade talks heating up
items.text:
